verdict: Amazon's sales rose 17% to $181.5B and AWS growth accelerated to 28% — while a $16.8B paper gain on its Anthropic stake lifted net income to $30.3B.

segments.name: North America
segments.note: Stores, subscriptions and advertising in the US, Canada and Mexico; earned $8.3B of operating income.

segments.name: International
segments.note: Stores and subscriptions outside North America (+11% before currency effects); earned $1.4B of operating income.

segments.name: AWS
segments.note: Amazon Web Services cloud computing — its fastest growth in 15 quarters; earned $14.2B of operating income, 59% of Amazon's total.

otherDetail: Total non-operating income of $15,982M: $15,647M of other income — including $16.8B of pre-tax gains on Amazon's Anthropic investment — plus $1,135M of interest income, less $800M of interest expense. Equity-method activity took off another $19M after tax.
follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: AWS is re-accelerating
takeaways.text: AWS sales grew 28% to $37.6B — the fastest in 15 quarters — and produced $14.2B of operating income: 59% of Amazon's total profit from 21% of its sales. Amazon's own chips business passed a $20B annual run rate.

takeaways.title: Anthropic gains did heavy lifting in profit
takeaways.text: Net income of $30.3B includes $16.8B of pre-tax paper gains on Amazon's stake in Anthropic. The stores and cloud operations themselves produced $23.9B of operating income.

takeaways.title: AI building is swallowing the cash flow
takeaways.text: Free cash flow for the last twelve months fell to $1.2B from $25.9B a year earlier, because spending on property and equipment jumped $59.3B year over year — mostly AI data centers — even as operating cash flow rose 30% to $148.5B.

oneTimers: Pre-tax gains of $16.8B on Amazon's investment in Anthropic are included in non-operating income — the main reason net income ($30.3B) is so much larger than operating income ($23.9B).
